'''Deputy governor''' was an elected position on the [[Mon Calamari Council|Dac Council]]. Each district on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] as well as each of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] colonies elected governors and deputy governors every two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to serve on the Council.<ref name="Strongholds" />
